# Local Knowledge Graph

- The architecture is canonical SQLite plus an optional rebuildable Ladybug graph projection. `src/kg/evidence/schema.sql` defines `evidence-store/3`: exact supplied text/revisions, identities, knowledge schema, entities/assertions, evidence and history remain authoritative in SQLite. Graph files contain no unique authored truth; never use leftover files as proof of freshness.
- `src/kg/evidence/` owns intake, authorization and exact evidence; `knowledge/` owns schema/knowledge reads and enrichment support; `indexing/` owns passages, vectors and canonical full search; `processing/` owns the control plane; `query/` composes supported canonical queries; `diagnostics/` owns bounded reports. `models/` defines values, not execution by itself.
- `src/kg/graph/` implements the private complete exact-scope Ladybug builder and `LocalGraphSession` reusable lifecycle, typed cited one-hop `traverse`, content-free capabilities, controlled writes and cleanup. Graph joins/retained inspection are not implemented. Preserve original observer/final fencing, exact scopes and per-operation budgets; saved canonical receipts survive graph failure. The pinned optional runtime is `ladybug==0.20.4`, supported on macOS 15+ ARM64/CPython 3.12. Its 256 MiB buffer pool/two threads are not a total RSS cap or crash boundary; in-process native failures can terminate the host. Base-package imports/search do not require Ladybug.
- The separate Markdown demonstration uses `config.py`, `markdown/`, `ingest/`, `retrieval/`, `cli.py`, and `src/kg/schema.sql`/`db.py`. Its manifests, SQLite database and `kg` CLI are not the canonical evidence-service interface or a Ladybug query facade. Do not route canonical schema changes to the demo schema.
- `tests/` contains unit, CLI, ingestion, acceptance, and benchmark tests.
- `corpora/` contains manifests and synthetic fixtures; `examples/` contains client usage; `benchmarks/` contains real-world evaluation tooling and results.
- Start with `README.md` for usage, `SPEC.md` for behavior and architecture, and `CONTRIBUTING.md` for development rules and validation commands.
- Use `.github/skills/use-knowledge-graph/SKILL.md` when operating the KG as an agent. Keep its interface recipes, capability boundaries and stopping rules current in the same change that delivers or alters public behavior; do not advertise planned APIs as shipped.
- `CONTRACTS.md` documents executable service APIs and separately identifies validation-only `foundation/1` values. Supplied-document intake, passage indexing and explicitly submitted knowledge exist; automatic knowledge extraction, a natural-language planner and live connectors do not. [Open bounded issues](https://github.com/markgar/local-knowledge-graph/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20is%3Aopen) own actionable scope, dependencies, designs and acceptance; [milestones](https://github.com/markgar/local-knowledge-graph/milestones) group goals. Follow the selected issue's current body and linked approved requirements, not superseded tracker instructions. Keep repo docs about existing behavior and executable assets, not future plans.
- Preserve exact evidence/history within a supported store. Experimental canonical format changes may require an explicit fresh store/reload; migration, dual-read and backward compatibility are not required. Never silently alter or delete an incompatible store.
- Use the `work-package` skill in `.github/skills/work-package/SKILL.md` when preparing or resuming a package design. Follow `CONTRIBUTING.md`: write specs in session artifact storage outside the tracked repo, obtain independent critique and approval before coding, and publish the full approved spec and review/approval record as an ordinary comment on its package issue. Verify publication before implementation; update the same spec comment for later approved revisions. Do not block on the special issue-artifact feature.
- CI is manual-only and for code-affecting changes. Do not dispatch it or run the full Python suite for documentation/skill-text/instruction-only changes; check their diff and relevant links instead. Follow the classification in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- Preserve deterministic behavior, immutable provenance, exact source anchors, corpus isolation, and generic configuration-driven logic.
